articles.title: Anselmi, sobre el penalti anulado al Elche en Villarreal: “Los errores de procedimiento son completamente evitables”
articles.standfirst: El técnico franjiverde asegura que el equipo está centrado en el encuentro de este sábado (14:00 horas), pese a la incertidumbre sobre una posible suspensión en Vallecas
articles.summary: El técnico franjiverde asegura que el equipo está centrado en el encuentro de este sábado (14:00 horas), pese a la incertidumbre sobre una posible suspensión en Vallecas
articles.body: Martín Anselmi ha alzado la voz sobre la polémica arbitral que perjudicó al Elche CF el pasado domingo en Villarreal. El Comité Técnico de Árbitros (CTA) reconoció posteriormente que el VAR no debió intervenir en la acción que terminó con la anulación del penalti señalado por un agarrón a Revivo. En la previa de la visita al Rayo Vallecano, este sábado a las 14:00 horas, el entrenador franjiverde ha expresado su malestar por lo sucedido, aunque ha reiterado su confianza en el colectivo arbitral. “Lo que me genera malestar es cuando se cometen en cualquier ámbito errores de procedimiento”, ha afirmado Anselmi, que ha explicado que, tras reunirse con responsables arbitrales en un encuentro de entrenadores, se llevó una impresión positiva de su voluntad de mejorar y actuar con transparencia. Sin embargo, considera que este tipo de equivocaciones deben evitarse. “Para este tipo de ambiente tienes que estar altamente cualificado para llevar a cabo este tipo de procedimientos, porque tenemos una presión muy alta. Para el Elche no es lo mismo estar en Primera que en Segunda. Los errores de procedimiento son completamente evitables”, ha subrayado. El técnico ha lamentado que el equipo no pueda recuperar una decisión que pudo tener incidencia en el resultado: “Nadie nos devolverá el penalti, al haber un error de procedimiento. Nos equivocamos todos”. Más allá de la polémica, Anselmi quiere que el Elche mantenga la atención en el encuentro de Vallecas, marcado por la incertidumbre sobre una posible suspensión debido a la situación del Rayo. El argentino ha asegurado que el ruido externo no altera la preparación del equipo y que su única preocupación es el partido. “Si ponemos el foco en ese ruido, no lo consumo. Hasta hace cinco minutos estaba viendo cómo inicia el Rayo y el entrenamiento de hoy. No es un tema que podamos controlar”, ha explicado. No obstante, ha recordado que un aplazamiento perjudicaría tanto al equipo como a los aficionados desplazados y ha reclamado que LaLiga actúe con contundencia si finalmente se produjera esa situación. En el plano deportivo, el preparador franjiverde espera un rival intenso, con capacidad para presionar y castigar en las transiciones. “Tienen un gran entrenador. Es un equipo que apuesta mucho por los ataques rápidos. Tenemos que luchar porque va a ser un rival en un escenario muy duro”, ha advertido. El Elche llega después de dos empates sin goles, ante el Celta y el Villarreal, una dinámica que Anselmi analiza desde la capacidad de controlar los partidos, aunque reconoce que habrá ajustes por realizar. “Me gusta la versión del Elche que estamos viendo porque me gusta controlar”, ha señalado. Para la cita, el técnico no podrá contar con Marc Aguado, cuya ausencia se prolongará hasta después del próximo parón de selecciones. “Es una baja sensible porque es muy importante para nosotros”, ha reconocido, aunque ha asegurado que dispone de alternativas para sustituirlo. Anselmi también ha destacado la concentración de sus futbolistas en Villarreal, una de las cuestiones que más valora del equipo, y ha incluido a Dituro entre los jugadores que le dejaron buenas sensaciones. Ahora, el Elche buscará trasladar esa solidez a Vallecas para intentar convertir las buenas sensaciones en una victoria que le permita avanzar en la clasificación.

articles.title: ESPN College GameDay 2026 Week 8 Location Hosts, TV Schedule and Predictions
articles.summary: While ESPN's College GameDay was very SEC-centric early in the year, it is in the midst of a welcome SEC break. The fan-favorite pregame show was in Provo last week, ahead of a pivotal matchup between Notre Dame and BYU.
articles.body:
While ESPN's College GameDay was very SEC-centric early in the year, it is in the midst of a welcome SEC break. The fan-favorite pregame show was in Provo last week, ahead of a pivotal matchup between Notre Dame and BYU.

The Cougars managed to outlast the Irish, though not everyone was satisfied with the finish.

This week, College GameDay will remain focused on the Big 12, and it will remain in Utah. The crew will be in Salt Lake City to help fans prepare for a battle between 10th-ranked Utah and No. 14 Houston.

Here's a look at what to expect, including scheduling information and predictions for the headline matchup.

Venue: Presidents Circle, University of Utah campus in Salt Lake

Crew: Rece Davis, Kirk Herbstreit, Desmond Howard, Pat McAfee, and Nick Saban

Saturday night's matchup will be huge for two teams hoping to make a run at the Big 12 Championship this year.

BYU remains at the top of the conference standings and is ranked second in the country after last week's win over Notre Dame. Like BYU, Texas Tech is at the top of the Big 12 standings and has an undefeated record. The Red Raiders are also ranked eighth in the country.

The Utes also sport an undefeated record and could potentially leapfrog Texas Tech with a win over Houston, as the Red Raiders will take on unranked Cincinnati this week. Houston has a 5-1 record and will probably need help to reach the Big 12 Championship Game.

The Cougars certainly can't afford a loss this week. Their first came against Texas Tech, and a second conference loss would be extremely difficult to overcome.

Utah is favored in the matchup for a couple of reasons, one being standout quarterback Devon Dampier. The third-year starter is completing a career-high 68.6 percent of his passes this season and leads an offense that ranks eighth in the nation in points per game (40.2).

The Utes' defense has allowed just 14.8 points per game (11th).

Houston has a potent offense of its own, led by quarterback Conner Weigman, who was last week's Big 12 Offensive Player of the Week.

Weigman leads an offense that ranks 13th in points per game (39.3). There's a very good chance that he'll be able to outpace Dampier and deliver an upset victory on the road. Whichever quarterback makes the fewest mistakes is likely to emerge as the victor.

While it would be foolish to discount Weigman, Patrick Overmyer, Re'Shaun Sanford II, and the rest of the Cougars' offense, it is fair to question Houston's 45th-ranked defense. The unit isn't a complete liability, but it hasn't been as consistent as Utah's defense.

The prediction here is that Utah's defense and home-field advantage allow the Utes to win the turnover battle and emerge with their first victory over Houston in six attempts.

articles.title: El Betis descarta la vía cautelar para Facundo
articles.standfirst: La entidad no descarta recurrir
articles.summary: La entidad no descarta recurrir
articles.body: El Betis no solicitará la suspensión cautelar de la sanción impuesta a Facundo Pellistri. Aunque la entidad verdiblanca todavía estudia si presenta recurso contra el castigo, la decisión adoptada es que el futbolista empiece a cumplir la sanción de inmediato. En el club entienden que aplazar el cumplimiento mediante una cautelar podría provocar que la sanción terminara ejecutándose en un momento mucho más comprometido de la temporada. Por ese motivo, se ha optado por asumir el castigo ahora y evitar que una eventual resolución desfavorable obligue al jugador a perderse partidos de mayor trascendencia más adelante. La entidad heliopolitana analizará en los próximos días si mantiene la vía del recurso para intentar reducir o revocar la sanción, pero sin alterar el calendario de cumplimiento de la misma. El objetivo es evitar incertidumbres futuras y tener cuanto antes resuelta la situación del futbolista.

articles.title: Mbappé, lanzado a su jardín
articles.standfirst: Con 12 goles en 12 partidos, apunta ahora a Barcelona, ciudad en la que ha anotado ocho de sus 12 goles a los culés... en sólo tres visitas
articles.summary: Con 12 goles en 12 partidos, apunta ahora a Barcelona, ciudad en la que ha anotado ocho de sus 12 goles a los culés... en sólo tres visitas
articles.body: Los registros de Kylian Mbappé en la temporada 26-27 son absolutamente redondos: 12 goles en 12 partidos, nueve en nueve de Liga y tres en tres de Champions. El goleador del Real Madrid apunta ahora su mira a Barcelona, un escenario que se le da especialmente bien. Allí ha anotado nada menos que ocho goles, cinco con el PSG y tres con el Madrid en sólo tres visitas, aunque su balance con los catalanes a nivel colectivo tenga saldo negativo: seis derrotas y tres victorias en diez partidos. De blanco le ha ido especialmente mal, pues ha perdido cinco de los seis clásicos disputados desde que llegó a España en 2024. Mbappé confía en que la dinámica cambie este domingo, un empeño en el que el Madrid depende de forma notable de los goles del francés. En este arranque de curso, su promedio es perfecto, un gol limpio por partido. De hecho, su nombre no subió al registro de los goleadores blancos en las dos derrotas del equipo hasta ahora, en los estadios de Betis y Atlético. "Le robé el gol a Mbappé porque sabía que él iba a marcar después", dijo tras la victoria ante el Leipzig Arda Güler, que se apuntó el segundo tanto de la noche ante los alemanes al tocar de espuela sobre la línea un remate de cabeza de Mbappé que iba dentro. A Kylian no le importó y celebró el gol del turco entre bromas, porque, en efecto, su momento acabó llegando. Un pase de Diomande desde el costado izquierdo permitió al francés controlar y lanzar un derechazo a la escuadra izquierda de Vandevoordt, el portero belga del equipo de Red Bull, que realizó varias paradas de mérito en el Bernabéu, como su compatriota Courtois en la otra portería. Como casi siempre, Mbappé acabó reclamando su cuota de protagonismo. A tres goles de los 100 con el Madrid antes del partido de Champions, el margen se estrecha. La redonda cifra está a tiro de doblete en Barcelona, una hazaña para muchos pero casi rutina para Kiki. En su primera visita, en 2021, hizo un 'hat-trick', y un doblete cuando, de nuevo con el PSG, volvió al estadio del Barça tres años después. Ya en la 24-25, nuevo triplete, ya con el Madrid (Montjuic), aunque no bastó para impedir el triunfo de los locales por 4-3. Mbappé defiende además en Barcelona su condición de doble Pichichi de la Liga española. Los galardones de sus dos primeras temporadas de blanco se ven amenazados ahora por dos jugadores del Barcelona, con arranques de temporada igulamente estratosféricos. Raphinha manda en la carrera con tres goles de ventaja sobre Kylian (12-9), con Lamine (8) amenazando la segunda posición del francés. De cómo acabe este triple pulso el domingo dependerá en gran medida el resultado del partido, al que Mbappé llega lanzado en un escenario siempre propicio para él.

articles.title: El líder de este proyecto no puede dinamitar la temporada en octubre: Bordalás debe pedir perdón
articles.standfirst: La opinión de Emilio Contreras
articles.summary: La opinión de Emilio Contreras
articles.body: Bordalás es una leyenda en el Getafe, el mejor entrenador de su historia y alguien que ha conquistado el corazón de la afición azulona como nadie lo hará. Esto son evidencias. Si el Getafe está entre los mejores de nuestro fútbol es gracias al técnico alicantino. Su década en el banquillo es inmejorable. Por eso tiene la admiración de todos los que forman la familia azulona. Pero sus incendiarias declaraciones tras el 2-5 ante el Lugano han manchado su impoluta imagen. Están fuera de lugar. No le puedes quitar la razón en muchas cosas a Bordalás: la plantilla no es competitiva para tres competiciones y el nivel del equipo da mucho miedo en una temporada que debería ser de ilusión por la vuelta a Europa por cuarta vez en la historia. Está en juego el proyecto de futuro de un Getafe que quiere ser más grande con un nuevo Coliseum que tiene una pinta maravillosa. No puedes dinamitar la temporada en pleno mes de octubre. Bordalás acusa a Ángel Torres de "engañarle", pero el técnico sabe mejor que nadie los problemas con el límite salarial de un Getafe cuyas altas fichas han lastrado la confección de la plantilla. Y que eso no iba a cambiar. Lo sabía en mayo y decidió renovar por dos campañas. De hecho, Bordalás tuvo una suculenta oferta encima de la mesa de Osasuna por dos temporadas y a última hora decidió declinar la opción que le ofreció Braulio y quedarse en el Getafe, que tenía ya firmado a Fabio Celestini si el alicantino se marchaba... como era su intención. Lo peor de las declaraciones de Bordalás fue que dejó en muy mal lugar a jugadores, director deportivo y presidente para pensar en sí mismo y hablar de "mi prestigio" y de que "mi imagen queda deteriorada". Sorprendió ver a alguien que siempre pone por delante el colectivo frente a lo individual hablara de sí mismo y no protegiera al grupo. Seguro que Bordalás habrá recapacitado en estas últimas horas y buscará la mejor solución para que el Getafe salga de esta con su líder al frente. Porque eso nadie lo duda. Bordalás lidera este proyecto del Eurogeta y hay que volver a reconducirlo tras cruzar la línea roja por unas declaraciones desafortunadas. Por eso, lo mejor es pedir perdón y apagar el incendio. Cuanto antes mejor.

articles.title: No. 10 Utah Suspends DT Jamal Wallace from Program After Arrest in Alleged Domestic Incident
articles.summary: SALT LAKE CITY (AP) — No. 10 Utah has suspended reserve defensive tackle Jamal Wallace after his arrest earlier this month tied to an alleged domestic violence incident.
articles.body:
SALT LAKE CITY (AP) — No. 10 Utah has suspended reserve defensive tackle Jamal Wallace after his arrest earlier this month tied to an alleged domestic violence incident.

According to KSL-TV in Salt Lake City , Wallace was arrested after a woman he had been dating said he raped her and shared videos of the alleged incident with others via social media. Wallace was charged with five counts of distribution of an intimate image.

Wallace was processed for his arrest at the Salt Lake County Jail on Oct. 11 and released a day later.

"We were made aware of the situation with Jamal Wallace on Oct. 11 and he was immediately placed on an indefinite suspension from the program," the school said in a statement Thursday. "We take these matters seriously. As this is a pending legal matter we have no further comment at this time."

The woman told police the two were having a converation about "infidenlity and their relationship" when he grabbed her head and forced her to perform oral sex, KSL reported, citing a probable cause statement. The woman later said he forcibly had sex with her, according to the documents, and she told police Wallace used her cellphone to take video and send it to five people on Snapchat, KSL reported.

Salt Lake police said they found videos of the incident in which the phone was "in his possession," the station reported.

Wallace spent the previous two seasons at Tennessee after starting his career in junior college at Sierra College. He appeared for the Utes only in the season opener against Idaho.

The Utes host No. 14 Houston on Saturday.

articles.title: Birmingham City: Former Manchester United chief John Murtough appointed as director of football
articles.summary: Birmingham City appoint ex-Manchester United chief John Murtough as director of football.
articles.body:
Birmingham City have appointed former Manchester United chief John Murtough as their new director of football.

Murtough, 55, who left United in April 2024 as football director after 11 years at Old Trafford, becomes the replacement for Craig Gardner, who departed St Andrew's in June.

Murtough, who has also worked for Everton, Fulham and Coventry City, was with the Premier League before joining Manchester United in 2013.

His most recent role was in Serie A as director of global development at Atalanta.

Murtough will begin his role at US-owned Birmingham on Monday - following this weekend's Championship game at Cardiff City.

Blues currently sit fourth in the Championship after a run of three straight wins since the international break under head coach Chris Davies.

Birmingham Sports Quarter - what you need to know

In a statement, Birmingham have said Davies "will report into" Murtough, while his remit also covers recruitment, data, performance and the pathway from the academy into the first team.

Murtough will also "collaborate with Hope Powell to ensure that the Blues women's team, enjoy "continued development benefits from the club's wider football strategy", while his remit also includes

Blues, twice Women's Super League runners-up in 2011 and 2012, currently sit 13th, one place off the bottom, in the table.

"This is a great football club with brilliant fans and enormous potential" said Murtough. "There is a clear determination from Knighthead to build something special for the long term, both on and off the pitch."

In a board statement, owners Knighthead Capital Management said: "We have been clear from the outset about our ambition for this club and for the city of Birmingham.

"We want Birmingham City competing at the highest level of English football and we are building for sustained success, both on and off the pitch."

Murtough began his career working alongside David Moyes at Everton as a sports scientist, working his way up to become head of performance before leaving in 2012 to become Premier League head of elite performance.

He then joined Man United in 2013, going on to become head of football development, before being promoted to football director in March 2020 a role that gave him "overall leadership and responsibility for operations and strategy across all football functions".

He was at the helm in an era that brought the sacking of Ole Gunnar Solksjaer , the short-term appointments of Michael Carrick and then Ralf Rangnick , before the unveiling of Erik ten Hag . But he had left before ten Hag was sacked in October 2024 .

Jadon Sancho , for £73m, Anthony, the second-most expensive player in the club's history when he signed from Ajax for £81.3m, Rasmus Hojlund for £72m and Mason Mount , for £55m, were all recruited under his watch.

'Murtough brings a wealth of experience' - Analysis

BBC Radio WM's Blues reporter Richard Wilford

The arrival of John Murtough is another visible sign of the club's ambition.

He brings with him a wealth of experience, much of which has come at the highest level.

Identifying Craig Gardner's successor was not a quick process after the former Blues midfielder stepped aside in spring.

Gardner had played a significant role in the change of ownership and the rapid recovery from relegation to League One.

Murtough's appointment comes at a time of great optimism on the field under Chris Davies. Blues are in the top four of the Championship and the women's team are trying to re-establish themselves in the WSL.

There was some concern in the summer about the lack of football experience at St Andrew's filling the gap between the owners and the coaching staff.

The choice of Murtough will go a long way towards calming those worries.

articles.title: Aston Villa: Unai Emery's impressive 2.0 reboot has supporters buoyant again
articles.summary: Unai Emery's impressive 2.0 reboot has Aston Villa's fans in buoyant mood on the fourth anniversary of his appointment, says chief football writer Phil McNulty.
articles.body:
When Aston Villa walked out to face Viking in the Champions League, a giant tifo emblazoned with the message 'We've Conquered Before. We're Prepared For More' dropped down from Villa Park's famous Holte End.

At the same time, Villa manager Unai Emery was striding along the touchline to a standing ovation as he took the acclaim from supporters.

Emery celebrates the fourth anniversary of his appointment from Villarreal when Villa face Premier League leaders Manchester City at Villa Park on Saturday lunchtime, his arrival a transformative moment for one of the great old footballing institutions.

He has written his name into Villa Park history, adding to a track record there and at other clubs that marks him down as one of the game's elite operators.

And it was reflected in every moment against Viking with an emphatic victory.

Villa Park's mood was buoyant and expectant - restored to the state of optimism that came with last season's Europa League triumph following a campaign that saw 54-year-old Emery return the club to the Champions League.

It was in sharp contrast to some trepidation weeks earlier after a summer which saw a host of big names depart and Villa deliver what has become something of a trademark under Emery, a slow start that usually ends with the closure of the transfer window.

The scale of change at Villa can be underscored by the fact six of the starting line-up that won the Europa League with a 3-0 win against Freiburg in Istanbul in May left during the summer.

Norwegians Viking were duly dispatched 3-1 amid more jubilation, Villa making it three wins from three and actually topping the standings in the Champions League table until Peter Christiansen's late goal for the visitors left them level on nine points with holders Paris St-Germain, Liverpool , Real Madrid and Real Betis.

It followed on from the 6-0 win against Fenerbahce in the Champions League at Villa Park. Villa have now won 12 European home games in a row, under the great specialist Emery.

Little wonder, then, that Emery was elated as he looked ahead to Saturday's meeting with Manchester City , who have a 100% record from seven games.

Villa Park is certain to be high on excitement and emotion as Emery said: "Those three points fills us with confidence. We are comfortable, and of course as well getting balance, because after this match we are going to play against Barcelona, favourites, and then we play against Galatasaray away."

He also noted how Villa Park is right on board with his impressive transition into what can be described as "Villa 2.0", saying: "We now try to focus now on the Manchester City game on Saturday, hopefully the same atmosphere, the same energy. I am so, so happy but we must keep moving forward with the challenges we are going to face.

"There's still a lot of work to do, so how we are responding, getting better, is really fantastic."

Emery, if it is possible, appeared even more animated than usual during the Viking game, looking energised by the renewal he had to perform in the summer and the promise shown by Villa's new players.

The list of summer departures looked daunting, with keeper Emiliano Martinez, Lucas Digne and Youri Tielemans leaving, along with England trio Ollie Watkins, Ezri Konsa and Morgan Rogers - the latter duo to Arsenal and Chelsea for a combined total of £172m as Villa raked in about £320m.

They had been integral to that Europa League win, the club's first European trophy for 44 years when they won the European Cup, and first domestic triumph since the League Cup win in 1996.

Villa's start to the season was slow, losing 4-0 at Brighton - with all four goals scored before half-time - then 1-0 at home to Arsenal . A goalless draw at Hull City was followed by 2-1 loss to Nottingham Forest at Villa Park.

The duck was broken with their first win at Spurs . Suddenly Villa and Emery looked like their old selves, culminating in those victories against Fenerbahce, a fine 1-0 win at Newcastle United , and Viking.

And what will please Emery and Villa's fans - who never wavered in their total faith in the manager they worship - is how the new signings have been contributing, suggesting the magician has produced a winning formula again, and quickly.

It will come as no surprise given Emery's back catalogue of work, which includes three successive Europa League wins with Sevilla, another with Villarreal and of course Villa's triumph. Even in what is regarded as an unrewarding spell at Arsenal , he still took them to the final of competition in 2019, although they lost to Chelsea .

It is why Villa's hierarchy, led by co-owner, Nassef Sawiris, give Emery everything he requires where possible.

Alongside sales, Villa spent £280m, and the early signs are they have invested wisely.

Against Viking, 20-year-old Brazilian Alysson, playing on the right flank, was Villa's most impressive performer. He preceded the summer signings, arriving from Gremio in January in a deal that could eventually be worth £10.4m.

He terrorised Viking with his pace, and even if his finishing still appears raw, he looks a superb prospect. Alysson won a penalty for Emiliano Buendia to put Villa two up, then ended a surging run by seeing his cross deflected into his own net by Henrik Heggheim for the third.

Ibrahim Mbaye, an 18-year-old signed in a £47m deal from Paris Saint-Germain, also showed flashed of rich promise on the other wing, a tantalising future partnership for Villa fans.

He appeared in all four of Senegal's matches at the 2026 World Cup, netting in a 3-1 defeat by France to become the youngest African player to score at a men's World Cup.

New keeper Zion Suzuki, the 24-year-old Japan keeper brought in from Parma for £30m, had big gloves to fill in replacing cult hero Martinez, but has looked assured, with the added bonus of an outstanding range of short and long passing that gives Villa an added dimension.

Joao Gomes, the midfielder in at £38m from Wolverhampton Wanderers, also showed what he offers against Viking.

Emery turned to a player who knew well to replace Watkins after he left to join Al-Hilal in the Saudi Pro League, signing Nicolas Jackson, who he coached at Villarreal, for £65m from Chelsea . He has settled quickly with five goals already.

Arguably the most exciting arrival of all is Johan Manzambi, a break-out World Cup star with Switzerland. The 21-year-old midfielder cost a little more than £50m from Freiburg. It was a deal pulled out from under the noses of Newcastle United , leaving then manager Eddie Howe devastated.

He piled on the agony with the winner at St James' Park after scoring on his full debut in the victory at Spurs , although he is currently a doubt to face Manchester City .

Emery has not just made it a case of out with the old and in with the new as he rebuilds Villa.

Captain John McGinn remains the heartbeat of his side, while former England midfielder Ross Barkley is undergoing a late career renaissance.

The 32-year-old scored against Viking, his fourth this season, also scoring twice in the rout against Fenerbahce.

Barkley was a surprise signing from Luton Town in July 2024, having had a season on loan at Villa Park in the 2020-21 season.

Emery is a huge admirer and said after the win against Viking: "As a person, he is a fantastic guy. Ross Barkley is a very good player with experience, and his career, I don't know why, was going down after Chelsea .

"When we watched him at Luton, we thought, 'wow, what a player'. I am so happy with how he is playing, always being respectful whether he is playing or not. I am pushing him a lot offensively. I know he can score and can head the ball. I am very demanding of him offensively. I am happy for him."

It is in Emery's demanding nature to push his players a lot, although no harder than he pushes himself.

And it why those early concerns about how Villa would handle the departure of so many important, high-profile, players have been banished before Manchester City come to Villa Park.

articles.title: B/R's Final 2026 Men's Ballon d'Or Rankings
articles.summary: The men's Ballon d'Or winner for 2026 will be revealed in London on Monday.
articles.body:
The men's Ballon d'Or winner for 2026 will be revealed in London on Monday.

With no clear front-runner this year, the debate over who should take home the trophy has been more varied than usual. After the previous update to these rankings in July following the World Cup, the latest odds suggest Ousmane Dembele, Jude Bellingham and Michael Olise have dropped out of serious consideration.

Harry Kane remains the favorite, and he could become the first Englishman to win the award since Michael Owen in 2001.

Read on to find out who else is in contention, and let us know who you think should win in the comments section on the B/R app.

Rodri won the Golden Ball as the best player at the World Cup. He played almost every minute for the tournament winners, Spain, and looked to have reclaimed the form that saw him win the Ballon d'Or in 2024.

It has not been a smooth path back to the top of the game, though. Rodri's ACL injury in late 2024 saw him miss eight months of action, and as is to be expected with a major injury, the midfielder didn't look like the same player for some time after making that comeback.

All that led to him being out of consideration for the Ballon d'Or prior to the World Cup. Even after being a key factor in Manchester City's unsuccessful late charge for the Premier League title, Rodri just hadn't quite hit the pre-injury levels that made him so special.

That changed in the United States, though, where Rodri's abilities both in and out of possession were crucial in Spain's victory.

As Andrew Beasley wrote for The Guardian , "Rodri's influence is best highlighted by Spain's record with Opta-defined big chances. They allowed only five in their eight matches. Cape Verde's one came from a corner after Rodri had been substituted, while Darwin Núñez failed to make proper contact when another came his way in the Uruguay match.

"The other three, none of which occurred after the quarter-final, were all headers. For two, the creating cross came from Spain's left, not Rodri's side. Teams very occasionally played around their midfield but never through it."

In a year without an obvious winner, the voting panel could do worse than select a player who shone brightest on the biggest stage.

While Khvicha Kvaratskhelia didn't factor into B/R's last set of Ballon d'Or rankings, the bookies are surprisingly buoyant regarding the Georgian's prospects, putting him as the fifth favorite above World Cup winner Rodri and Bayern Munich and France magician Michael Olise.

The absolutely horrendous injury that Kvara suffered in Paris Saint-Germain's 4-2 Champions League victory over Barcelona will sadly not be softened by a Ballon d'Or trophy, though, with the Georgian just a stone's throw away from a podium spot.

Even more unfortunately, that ACL injury will likely keep the 25-year-old out of action for the best part of a year, effectively ending his bid for the award in 2027.

However, he can look back on the 2025-26 campaign with great satisfaction, having doubled up on his career winners' medals in both Ligue 1 and the Champions League.

His nation missing out on the World Cup ultimately did the most damage to his case for the golden orb, with Kvara unable to put his talents on display for a global audience to enjoy.

At club level, though, he was typically electric. Despite PSG boss Luis Enrique effectively saving him for European action—limiting him to just 28 appearances and 18 starts in the French top flight—he still grabbed eight goals and four assists in league play, coming in at a goal-involvement rate of every 123.5 minutes.

But he truly made his presence felt in the best club competition on the planet, grabbing 10 goals and 6 assists in 16 games. In fact, he failed to make an impact on the scoresheet in only three of those appearances.

Kvaratskhelia scored two vital goals in the 5-4 barnburner against Bayern Munich in the semifinal first leg, and he added an assist in the second fixture. He also won the equalising penalty in the final against Arsenal, which PSG went on to win on penalties.

Those efforts were more than enough to earn the Georgian the Champions League's Player of the Season award.

Aside from the counting stats, Kvara consistently made defenders tremble as he burst down the wing, using his lightning pace, quick feet, smart movement, and sheer force of will to make it into the box before providing a game-defining moment.

It was difficult to know what to expect from Lionel Messi at the World Cup, with his time in Major League Soccer making it tough to judge how much he had left to give at the highest level.

The answer to those questions was fairly emphatic, though: His 12 goal contributions placed him second behind Kylian Mbappé, and he inspired Argentina back to the final four years after leading them to the trophy.

The performance was enough to thrust him into Ballon d'Or contention despite playing at a lower level of club competition in MLS. His 37 goal contributions in 27 league games with Inter Miami this season are essentially a footnote to his case.

Messi's World Cup performance surpassed lofty expectations, but the argument for placing him above the leading contenders rests largely on sentiment.

The eight-time Ballon d'Or winner has retired from international duty with Argentina. With the remainder of his club career likely to be spent in MLS or at a similar level elsewhere, this could be the 39-year-old's last realistic chance to win a ninth award.

It wouldn't be the first time a subjective honor has been awarded for such reasons, nor would it be the last. But the latest odds suggest Messi's career achievements and admirable World Cup swansong won't be enough to put him above the leading contenders still playing in the Champions League and other top club competitions.

Kylian Mbappé won't be entirely pleased with how his 2025-26 season played out, with the 27-year-old coming away empty-handed in terms of silverware.

However, the oddsmakers still have him as the third favorite to win the Ballon d'Or, thanks to the Frenchman securing the Golden Boot in La Liga, the Champions League, and the World Cup.

Across all competitions at club level, he scored 42 goals in 44 matches. In 16 games for France during the campaign, he bagged 16.

A hit rate of practically a goal per game for both club and country is absolutely absurd. But while the Ballon d'Or is essentially an award given to the best single footballer on the planet, that lack of team trophies almost certainly puts him out of contention for the top prize.

It's kind of strange that the Frenchman has only found himself on the podium once in his decorated career, with a third-place finish in 2023. He has been consistently phenomenal since his breakout season in 2016-17, and he's often talked about among the best players the game has ever seen. But the Ballon d'Or has so far proved elusive.

He's still got plenty of time in his career to claim the prize, and he's started off this season in scintillating form. However, Real Madrid are already six points behind Barcelona in La Liga, and another trophyless campaign might yet again put the award just out of reach in 2027.

It's only a matter of time until Lamine Yamal grabs the Ballon d'Or, and there is every chance it could happen in 2026.

While the player at the top of this list is the consensus favorite to scoop the 2026 prize, so was Vinicius Junior in 2024, and Rodri still snuck in ahead of the Brazilian to claim the award.

It's mad to think about everything Yamal has already achieved in his career, and the 2025-26 season was another banner year for the 19-year-old superstar.

Yamal scored 16 goals and added 12 assists as Barcelona cruised to the La Liga title, and he added 10 and four, respectively, in the Blaugrana's Champions League run, which ended at the quarterfinal stage.

And then we have the World Cup. While it was difficult to pick out a true top performer for a trophy-winning Spain side that was built on the collective, Yamal was still a standout in the knockout stages, having been eased back into action in the group phase.

In the semifinal, he spooked France left-back Lucas Digne into making a wild swing in the penalty box, which connected with Yamal's thigh and sent him tumbling. The resulting spot-kick was coolly dispatched by Mikel Oyarzabal, opening the scoring in an eventual 2-0 win.

In the final against Argentina, he was once again a terror, with a game-high four shots on goal and the most dribbles (5), according to Fotmob .

Headline performances in North America throughout the competition would have helped his case for the Ballon d'Or, but as it is, he ended the tournament with just a goal and an assist, which is an unfortunate mark against him in an otherwise brilliant summer (and season).

Harry Kane has 52 goal contributions in all of 2026. That's nine more than second-placed Michael Olise. His 41 goals also put him first among players who play in Top 5 club leagues, with second-placed Raphinha trailing by 13 goals.

He's also won the Bundesliga and the DFB-Pokal, and reached the semi-finals of the World Cup and the Champions League.

While those last two disappointments have prevented him from being a runaway leader, the raw figures are convincing enough for Kane to be the favorite to win the award. This is far from the first incredible statistical season in Kane's career, though, and he does seem to have found an extra level of performance that has put him on the level of a potential Ballon d'Or winner.

Maybe it is simply that the award can no longer be dominated by Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo, allowing others to shine brighter in their absence. But Kane's role as a playmaker for both England and Bayern Munich cannot be overstated.

In a timely reminder of that quality, Kane delivered an incredible pass for Alphonso Davies to score against Arsenal on Wednesday in the Champions League.

Gunners manager Mikel Arteta said Kane found "a space that doesn't exist" for the assist, and it's that consistent level of precision as both a scorer and creator that has put Kane at the top of this list.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia security puts Asian Cup in doubt: Japan football chief
articles.summary: Tsuneyasu Miyamoto says it will be difficult for Saudi Arabia to host next year’s tournament as scheduled.
articles.body:
The ongoing security situation in Saudi Arabia makes it difficult for the country to host football’s 2027 Asian Cup as scheduled, Japan Football Association President Tsuneyasu Miyamoto has warned.

Several major sporting events in Saudi Arabia have been cancelled or postponed amid escalating attacks by Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis, raising doubts over whether the continental tournament can take place as planned from January 7 to February 5 next year.

“Based on what I’ve learned from the news, the situation is still unsafe, so at this point, I don’t think it would be easy to hold the [Asian] Cup there,” Miyamoto told reporters at the Asian Football Confederation’s (AFC) extraordinary congress in Tokyo.

“I just had a meeting with the Saudi side and they said that their top priority is the safety of the players, the fans, and everyone who would be attending the tournament.”

“They said they would work with the AFC to decide whether the tournament can go ahead, so they did mention that it would take some time (to make that decision).”

Asian football chief Salman bin Ibrahim Al-Khalifa said last week a postponement until 2028 remained a possibility if necessary, but the local organising committee (LOC) later said it was sticking to the original schedule .

“Preparations across all organisational and operational areas are progressing according to the approved schedule, including work on venues, facilities and supporting services,” the LOC had said in a statement last week.

“(The LOC) will continue to monitor developments relevant to the tournament and ensure the appropriate conditions are in place for its successful delivery.”

Earlier this month, golf’s Asian Tour postponed the Saudi International indefinitely and cycling’s Urban World Championships were cancelled following a deadly attack on Riyadh’s international airport, which killed at least 12 people and wounded more than 300.

Other events have also been disrupted. The Six Kings Slam exhibition tennis tournament in Riyadh was moved from October to December, while FIFA postponed the FIFAe Finals 2026 video game competition in Jeddah until an unspecified date.

The Saudi government has invested heavily in sport through its Public Investment Fund (PIF) in recent years and the Asian Cup was pitched as an early rehearsal for hosting the FIFA World Cup in 2034.

articles.standfirst: El Barcelona-Real Madrid de este domingo tendrá una realización audiovisual a la altura de la grandeza del encuentro
articles.summary: El Barcelona-Real Madrid de este domingo tendrá una realización audiovisual a la altura de la grandeza del encuentro
articles.body: Llega una nueva edición del Clásico, el partido que cada temporada 'detiene' el mundo. Aunque LaLiga no ofrece datos concretos, se calcula una audiencia potencial de más de 650 millones de espectadores a nivel mundial. Lo que sí dice la patronal es que el Clásico atraviesa su mejor momento de audiencia y que las dos últimas ediciones han sido las más vistas. En las dos últimas temporadas, el encuentro ha reunido un 51% más de audiencia que en las cuatro anteriores. Casi nada. Será un Clásico 'de cuento': Disney ofrecerá el partido en Francia y en los países nórdicos. No será su primera vez que lo emita en el mundo, ya que ESPN, partner de LaLiga en territorio norteamericano, forma parte de Walt Disney Company, pero sí será su primera vez en los territorios anteriormente citados. DAZN, además de ser el encargado de retransmitirlo este domingo en España, lo emitirá también en Francia (al igual que Disney) y en el África subsahariana. Canal+ será el único operador en Polonia, en Brasil CazéTV lo emitirá en abierto y DirecTV ampliará su distribución en Argentina, donde además de DSports y DGO, la señal llegará también a Paramount+, Prime Video y Flow. Acuerdos para ampliar más aún la huella internacional del duelo entre los dos gigantes del fútbol español. Y para que no se escape nada, para contar cada detalle, cada historia dentro del partido, la señal internacional de El Clásico contará con uno de los mayores despliegues audiovisuales realizados por LaLiga. La producción, al tratarse de un partido modelo A+, contará con 38 posiciones de cámara, 39 si se tiene en cuenta la bodycam, que todavía no se sabe si los equipos querrán utilizar durante el calentamiento. La cifra supone trece más que en cualquier partido 'A' (partidos habituales del Barcelona y del Madrid), donde hay 25 ó 26 cámaras. Es decir, habrá 13 cámaras más que por ejemplo en el Real Madrid-Sevilla del pasado domingo. Habrá cámaras principales, de portería, de línea de gol, en banquillos y túnel... Un detalle que cobra especial interés en una semana en la que ha habido polémica por la falta de imágenes claras para determinar qué paso entre Güler y Peque. Con 38 cámaras, no debería escaparse nada. Una ayuda para el árbitro (no es oficial todavía, aunque Martínez Munuera aparece como favorito) y para el VAR. Entre las novedades destaca también el primer uso del balón conectado en un Clásico, que además de ayudar al arbitraje como lo viene haciendo desde principios de temporada, enriquecerá la retransmisión con datos y gráficos. El encuentro contará también con la presencia de la RefCam por segunda vez en un partido entre Barcelona y Real Madrid. La cámara arbitral ofrecerá una perspectiva singular de la toma de decisiones y del diálogo entre los jugadores y el árbitro, como ya se ha visto durante los últimos meses en otros encuentros. Otro detalle a nivel televisivo: la previa del partido se ampliará a 90 minutos, hora y media antes del comienzo del encuentro. Barcelona está siendo durante los últimos días, y hasta el próximo domingo, el gran centro de operaciones. En la temporada anterior se gestionaron más de 1.200 acreditaciones para el Clásico entre el partido de ida y el de vuelta. En esta edición, 28 operadores de 28 mercados diferentes (Estados Unidos, Francia, Brasil, Latinoamérica, África, Oriente Medio y Europa) viajarán a Barcelona para generar contenidos. De forma simultánea, LaLiga ha activado iniciativas en mercados estratégicos de América, Europa, Asia, África y Oriente Medio, en países como Estados Unidos, Brasil, Argentina, Chile, Colombia, México, China, Singapur, Sudáfrica o Jordania. LaLiga busca generar conversación mucho más allá de España y mucho más allá de los 90 minutos. Celebrities, leyendas de LaLiga y creadores de contenido ayudarán a ello. Está todo preparado para que antes, durante y después del partido, sea un gran Clásico. Durante el partido, dependerá de los protagonistas.

articles.title: Aranbarri: "No nos conformamos con generar, le damos mucho valor a la eficacia"
articles.standfirst: El preparador azulgrana tiene claro dónde están los puntos de mejora de su equipo
articles.summary: El preparador azulgrana tiene claro dónde están los puntos de mejora de su equipo
articles.body: El Eibar parte este viernes a Córdoba con la misión de volver con los tres puntos mañana por la tarde. Para ello, Jokin Aranbarri lleva toda la semana trabajando en la mejora de aquellos aspectos en los que el equipo ha sufrido en las últimas jornadas. Arrancar mejor los partidos, volver a ser eficaces en área rival y tratar de recuperar el hábito de la puerta cero son algunas de las premisas que se marca el Eibar en su visita a tierras andaluzas. La exigencia será máxima porque el Córdoba es un equipo que lleva al límite a todos sus rivales. "Es un muy buen rival, que juega a ritmos muy altos e intenta atacarte rápido. Cada vez que pierde el balón, va hacia adelante y defiende lejos de su portería. Será un partido de mucha tralla, en el que seguramente habrá muchos duelos. Es un equipo que no juega a medias: lo hace todo con intensidad. Lo importante es ser contundentes en cada momento y conseguir que el partido caiga de nuestro lado". Aranbarri es consciente de que volver a ser certeros en ataque será fundamental para sumar los tres puntos. "Trabajamos mucho en cómo llegamos al área rival, con qué jugadores y qué movimientos hacemos para generar esas oportunidades. Es verdad que ser eficaces tiene mucha importancia, especialmente en esta categoría, que es realmente difícil. Primero hay que generar ocasiones y después materializarlas. No nos conformamos con generar oportunidades: damos mucho valor a la eficacia". El técnico armero tendrá que tirar de todos sus jugadores para afrontar una semana en la que el Eibar disputará tres partidos en apenas siete días. "Tenemos en mente que afrontamos tres partidos en una semana, pero está todo bien organizado y tenemos claro lo que queremos en cada encuentro. Lo más importante es el partido de mañana. Sabemos la dificultad que conlleva y vamos con todo", sentencia.

articles.title: Conte se desmarca de los rumores del United: "No hay negociaciones avanzadas con ningún club"
articles.standfirst: El técnico italiano, uno de los nombres que han aparecido en Inglaterra como posible sustituto de Carrick, rompe su silencio y niega que exista una negociación en marcha
articles.summary: El técnico italiano, uno de los nombres que han aparecido en Inglaterra como posible sustituto de Carrick, rompe su silencio y niega que exista una negociación en marcha
articles.body: Mientras la continuidad de Michael Carrick sigue siendo objeto de debate en Inglaterra y los medios británicos multiplican las quinielas sobre posibles relevos en el banquillo del Manchester United, uno de los candidatos señalados ha decidido salir al paso de las especulaciones. Antonio Conte publicó un comunicado en sus redes sociales para aclarar que, pese a los numerosos rumores, no mantiene conversaciones avanzadas con ningún club. El entrenador italiano, cuyo nombre ha sido vinculado en las últimas horas a Old Trafford junto al de otros técnicos como Eddie Howe o Julian Nagelsmann, quiso zanjar las informaciones que apuntaban a contactos y exigencias previas para regresar a los banquillos. "Mi nombre ha sido vinculado a numerosos clubes, pero actualmente no existen negociaciones en una fase avanzada", aseguró Conte en un comunicado difundido este viernes. El exentrenador del Nápoles, que continúa sin equipo tras su exitosa etapa en el conjunto italiano, explicó que todavía no ha decidido cuándo volverá a entrenar. "Me tomaré el tiempo necesario para reflexionar sobre cómo y cuándo regresar a los banquillos. Será una decisión cuidadosamente meditada, que tomaré cuando considere que se dan las condiciones adecuadas", señaló. Otro de los aspectos que quiso aclarar Conte está relacionado con algunas informaciones aparecidas en distintos medios durante las últimas semanas. El técnico desmiente haber planteado condiciones económicas especiales o exigido plenos poderes deportivos a posibles pretendientes. "He leído informaciones sobre supuestas exigencias económicas y peticiones de control total. Estas informaciones carecen de fundamento", afirmó. Un mensaje que cobra especial relevancia en un momento en el que varios medios ingleses sitúan al italiano entre los entrenadores que estudia el Manchester United si la situación de Carrick continúa deteriorándose. Pese a negar contactos avanzados, Conte tampoco cierra la puerta a un futuro acuerdo. El italiano reconoce que analizará cualquier proyecto que considere adecuado. "Si surgiera una oportunidad real y concreta, ese será el momento de mantener conversaciones con el club en cuestión y valorar conjuntamente las condiciones de un posible acuerdo", explicó. Tras las recientes informaciones publicadas en Italia y en el extranjero, considero oportuno aclarar mi postura. Mi nombre ha sido vinculado a numerosos clubes, pero actualmente no existen negociaciones en una fase avanzada con ninguno de ellos. Después de una etapa maravillosa y exitosa al frente del Nápoles, me tomaré el tiempo necesario para reflexionar sobre cómo y cuándo regresar a los banquillos. Será una decisión cuidadosamente meditada, que tomaré cuando considere que se dan las condiciones adecuadas. He leído informaciones sobre supuestas exigencias económicas y peticiones de control total que, según se ha dicho, ya habría trasladado a algunos clubes. También he visto referencias a lo que se ha descrito como mi "fuerte personalidad". Estas informaciones carecen de fundamento, ya que actualmente no existe ninguna base concreta para realizar ese tipo de valoraciones. Si surgiera una oportunidad real y concreta, ese sería el momento de mantener conversaciones con el club en cuestión y analizar conjuntamente las condiciones de un posible acuerdo, teniendo en cuenta las necesidades de ambas partes, así como los principios, cualidades y la forma de trabajar que definen mi labor como entrenador. Hasta entonces, cualquier especulación sobre mis exigencias o sobre mi futuro profesional sigue siendo precisamente eso, especulación, y no debe tratarse como un hecho. Un cordial saludo, Antonio Conte.

articles.title: Manchester United: Antonio Conte dismisses 'unfounded' speculation
articles.summary: Antonio Conte says he is not in advanced talks with any club, in response to speculation he has held talks with Manchester United.
articles.body:
Antonio Conte has said he is not in "advanced negotiations" with any club in response to reports he has held talks with Manchester United.

Italian newspaper La Repubblica , external claimed on Thursday that Conte had held talks with United's board about replacing Michael Carrick following the 4-1 defeat against Como on Wednesday.

The report said the former Chelsea manager had demanded full control of United's transfer policy and stated his intention to appoint his own staff at Old Trafford.

But, while BBC Sport understands Conte is keen on the job, the Italian says he is not in "advanced" talks with any club.

"My name has been linked with numerous clubs, but there are currently no negotiations at an advanced stage," Conte wrote on Instagram.

"I have read reports of financial demands and requests for full control that I have supposedly already made to the clubs mentioned, as well as reservations about what has been described as my "strong personality". These reports are unfounded.

"Should a concrete opportunity arise, that will be the time to hold discussions with the club concerned and jointly consider the terms of a potential agreement, with due regard for both parties' needs and the qualities and approach that define my work as a manager."

Carrick's future at Old Trafford is uncertain after a humiliating defeat to Cesc Fabregas' Como in the Champions League earlier this week.

Although Carrick is set to remain in charge for Sunday's Premier League match against Bournemouth, sources have told BBC Sport that United have begun the process of identifying possible replacements.

Former Newcastle boss Eddie Howe, Conte and ex-Germany manager Julian Nagelsmann are all understood to have their eyes on the job.

Conte, who played for Juventus and Italy in a stellar career, is a free agent after leaving Napoli at the end of last season.

He won the Serie A title during his first season in Naples, before a Supercoppa Italiana victory in his final campaign.

The 57-year-old won the Premier League with Chelsea during his debut campaign at Stamford Bridge in 2016-17 and beat Manchester United in the FA Cup final the following season.

He returned to the Premier League in 2021 when he replaced Jose Mourinho at Tottenham Hotspur.

Conte's time in north London lasted just 16 months though, with the Italian leaving in March 2023 after criticising "selfish" players and the club's culture in a remarkable news conference.

Brighton manager Fabian Hurzeler has distanced himself from links to Old Trafford.

The German has been touted as a possible successor to Carrick given his free-scoring Brighton side are sitting third in the Premier League.

Hurzeler has a contract with the Seagulls until 2029 and says he is happy at the club.

"I am really focused on my job here. I have no time to think about these rumours because we play every three days," said Hurzeler.

"I have a lot of respect for Michael Carrick. He is a great human being, he is a great personality. Every time we meet each other, we have a really good relationship."

articles.title: Asia da carta blanca a Infantino
articles.standfirst: El cambio de postura y el apoyo de la Confederación Asiática (AFC) afianza a Gianni Infantino hacia su reelección el próximo 18 marzo en Rabat
articles.summary: El cambio de postura y el apoyo de la Confederación Asiática (AFC) afianza a Gianni Infantino hacia su reelección el próximo 18 marzo en Rabat
articles.body: El cambio de postura y el apoyo de la Confederación Asiática (AFC) da carta blanca a Gianni Infantino hacia su reelección el próximo 18 marzo en Rabat y cambia el guion de un proceso, en el que la oposición a este queda reducida a la UEFA y la CONCACAF, obligadas a diseñar una alternativa. Las palabras del jeque bareiní Salman bin Ebrahim Al Khalifa, en el Congreso que Asia ha celebrado en Japón, despejan dudas para la votación. Están muy lejos de los reproches que él mismo hizo a Infantino hace apenas tres meses y son un claro mensaje que debilita a su oposición. Los 47 votos de Asia serán determinantes entre las 211 federaciones de la FIFA. "Mientras miramos hacia un futuro más brillante y competitivo, nuestra solidaridad sigue siendo nuestra mayor fortaleza. Estamos listos para avanzar, unidos en apoyo del presidente de la FIFA, Gianni Infantino". Con esta afirmación, en presencia del propio Infantino en la capital japonesa, y horas después de que la FIFA confirmara que los últimos tres partidos de la Copa Intercontinental 2026 se disputarán en Catar, país que desde el principio se desmarcó de las de su confederación, Al Khalifa ha cambiado las fichas del tablero. El jaque apunta ahora a Europa (UEFA) y América Central y del Norte (CONCACF), con la salvedad de México. Derrotado por Infantino hace diez años en las elecciones en las que este llegó a la presidencia, Al Khalifa se alineó con los críticos hace apenas tres meses cuando el presidente desveló su idea de vender una participación de las competiciones de la FIFA a inversores externos, con el llamado proyecto FIFA Forward Entreprise (FFE). Primero le reprochó falta de transparencia y de consulta en una iniciativa de tal magnitud y luego, de la mano de UEFA (55 federaciones) y CONCACAF (41 federaciones) reclamó una revisión urgente de la gobernanza del organismo. Su nombre se volvió a barajar como posible candidato para la votación de marzo. Hoy, en el guion de su discurso, incluyó un abrazo a Infantino y confió en que la mayoría de los miembros de la AFC le respaldarán en unas elecciones, que entran en el tramo final para presentar candidaturas, con el 18 de noviembre como fecha tope para ello. La escena convierte en quimera la opción de un candidato alternativo consensuado por Asia, junto a UEFA y CONCACAF, que incluyó de entrada el nombre del presidente de la segunda, el canadiense Victor Montagliani, como candidato alternativo, una vez descartado Alexander Ceferin. El esloveno optará a un tercer mandato en UEFA, en abril de 2027 en Astaná. Este nuevo escenario llega una semana después de que Infantino pidiera disculpas por los errores cometidos en la gestión y comunicación del proyecto FFE, durante la primera reunión del Consejo después del Mundial celbrada el pasado día 15 en Zúrich (Suiza).

articles.title: Pitchwise entra en el Valencia con una inversión de 100 millones y una futura participación del 42%
articles.standfirst: La firma inversora adquirirá acciones de Meriton Holdings y aportará nuevo capital al club en una operación que valora la entidad en 1.250 millones
articles.summary: La firma inversora adquirirá acciones de Meriton Holdings y aportará nuevo capital al club en una operación que valora la entidad en 1.250 millones
articles.body: El Valencia anunció este viernes un acuerdo entre Meriton Holdings, principal accionista, y Pitchwise Holdings que supondrá la entrada del grupo inversor en el accionariado de la entidad y una aportación de 100 millones de euros de nuevo capital para el club. Según informó el Valencia en un comunicado oficial, Pitchwise adquirirá acciones a Meriton Holdings -pero no especifica el número- y llegará a ostentar una participación del 42 % de la entidad -y tampoco indica el plazo-. El comunicado no detalla qué porcentaje corresponde a la compra de acciones ni el importe que percibirá Meriton por la operación. Sí precisa que los 100 millones de euros estarán disponibles de forma inmediata para su inversión directa en el club. Un dato muy importante es que la operación valora al Valencia en 1.250 millones de euros. Según la entidad, esa valoración incluye los equipos masculino y femenino, el actual Camp de Mestalla y el proyecto del Nou Mestalla. Pitchwise Holdings es un consorcio integrado por family offices e inversores institucionales a largo plazo liderado por Ann Rodriguez y Corey Woolfolk. Entre los inversores que respaldan el proyecto figuran George Roberts, cofundador y copresidente ejecutivo de KKR; Henry Kravis, cofundador y copresidente ejecutivo de KKR; y Penner Sports Group. El comunicado señala que Meriton Holdings continuará siendo el accionista mayoritario del Valencia y que Kiat Lim seguirá ejerciendo como presidente dentro de la nueva estructura accionarial. También formarán parte de esta nueva etapa Ann Rodriguez y Corey Woolfolk. La entidad enmarca la operación en un momento clave marcado por el futuro traslado al Nou Mestalla, un proyecto que considera el hito más importante del club en el último siglo, con capacidad 70.000 espectadores, y que se inaugurará el próximo verano. En el comunicado, Kiat Lim afirma que la incorporación de Pitchwise supone el inicio de "una nueva era" para el Valencia y destacó la experiencia de los nuevos socios en inversión y gestión deportiva. Por su parte, Ann Rodriguez y Corey Woolfolk señalaron que el club dispone de los elementos necesarios para consolidarse como una referencia en el fútbol europeo, tanto en categoría masculina como femenina. La entrada de Pitchwise queda pendiente del cumplimiento de las condiciones habituales para el cierre de la operación, incluidas las correspondientes autorizaciones regulatorias.

articles.title: Carrick defends himself: It was unacceptable, but we'll bounce back
articles.summary: Michael Carrick has said Manchester United must end "a run we're not happy with at all".Manchester United are winless in seven games across all competitions...
articles.body:
Michael Carrick has said Manchester United must end "a run we're not happy with at all".

Manchester United are winless in seven games across all competitions and suffered a heavy 4-1 defeat to Como in the Champions League in midweek.

Tensions have come to light following recent comments from players, including Lisandro Martínez and Bruno Fernandes, who have strongly criticised the club's hierarchy.

Fernandes questioned Carrick's tactics during the defeat in Como, with the manager under pressure ahead of this weekend's match against Bournemouth.

Carrick declined to comment on whether he had spoken to Fernandes about his remarks this week, or whether he had considered stripping the 32-year-old of the captaincy.

At his pre-match press conference , Carrick said the Red Devils must bounce back from an "unacceptable" performance in the Champions League.

Manchester United manager Carrick demands a response after Como thrashing: "We've had a run we're not happy with at all".

"I just want to say a few things, really. We haven't had a good time lately. I think that's pretty obvious. So I fully accept what we're going through at the moment."

"We had five months of relative success, a period when I was happy with a lot of what I was seeing and what we were doing as a team."

"Recently we haven't been good enough. We've had a run we're not happy with at all."

"Wednesday was a bad night. It was a bad night for many reasons. It hurt me a lot."

"Obviously it hurt to see how we played, to see how the game unfolded. As I said after the game, it was really unacceptable."

"The fans are a fundamental part of this football club. For them to put in the effort, the time and the money they invest, only to feel what we all felt on Wednesday—it was a very tough moment."

articles.body:
Michael Carrick maintains he will "do what is best for this football club" after being pushed over Bruno Fernandes ' future as Manchester United captain.

The Portuguese's astonishing outburst in Como following a humiliating Champions League defeat, questioning Carrick's strategy and the team's decision to press against the Italians.

Speculation has followed over whether Fernandes will face internal discipline, just a week after Lisandro Martinez's criticism of the club.

But Carrick remains defiant and urged his group to show resiliency , though he stopped short of confirming his decision over Fernandes for this weekend's Premier League clash with Bournemouth, instead sharing a mysterious stance over his latest problem.

"The most important thing is the team and the dynamics of the squad and the football club and I always do what is best for the club," Carrick noted.

"Whatever the situation is I will do what is best for the football club.

"If I have spoken to him or I haven't spoken to him, I don't think this is the time to go into too much detail."

Carrick then reiterated how the club must revert back to its values and show how resilient they can be after a torrid run of form.

"It's important to recognise we haven't been doing it," Carrick added. "The foundation of the football club, the values of the football club have been put down for many years. I understand and get every one of them. It's humility, hard work and being proud to live up to the values.

"There's a resilience about this club that's been there for a long time. It runs very deep, I've seen it with my own eyes, I've felt it.

"We can never lose that, it inspires me a lot to live up to that. We've shown it, for a good period of time, we're capable of it, it's a moment where it's not gone well. Respect what it takes to win. I'm not entitled to be here, that cannot be at this football club, it doesn't mean you're entitled to win. It takes hard work and sacrifice."

articles.title: El Clasico: All to know about the rivalry between Barcelona and Real Madrid
articles.summary: One of world football’s biggest rivalries renews on Sunday when Barcelona host Real Madrid in La Liga’s El Clasico.
articles.body:
The excitement is mounting as El Clasico between Barcelona and Real Madrid approaches.

The rivalry, which spans more than a century, is one of the biggest in world football. On Sunday, both sides will vie to walk away from Camp Nou with bragging rights.

Here’s everything to know about the rivalry:

The rivalry between Barcelona and Real Madrid dates back to 1902, when the teams first met in the Copa de la Coronacion (a predecessor to the current-day Copa del Rey). Barcelona won the match 3-1 on May 13, 1902, at the La Castellana hippodrome in Madrid.

It took another six meetings before they finally faced each other in La Liga on February 17, 1929. Real won the match 2-1, thanks to Rafael Morera’s brace.

The formation of Spain’s top flight that year added further intensity to the rivalry.

The term El Clasico – “The Classic” in Spanish – first appeared in a local newspaper during the 1960s. By that time, the match had been long considered a huge derby.

The rivalry is now recognised as one of the biggest in world sport and, in the last two decades, has featured the era of Pep Guardiola vs Jose Mourinho in the dugouts and the small matter of Lionel Messi vs Cristiano Ronaldo on the pitch.

How did the El Clasico rivalry begin, and how has it evolved?

Madrid and Barcelona are the two largest cities in Spain – this is at the root of their rivalry, which also has deep political undertones.

In the 1930s, the divide between the two cities deepened. FC Barcelona, founded in 1899, came to symbolise Catalan independence, and Real, which came into existence three years later, represented Spanish nationalism.

The conflict between Real Madrid and Barcelona has long surpassed the sporting dimension, so much that elections to the clubs’ presidencies have been strongly politicised.

In recent times, the two clubs have been in a bitter war of words and ongoing legal disputes.

Earlier this month, Real Madrid submitted a 50,000-page dossier to European football’s governing body, UEFA, urging them to conclude their ongoing investigation into the Negreira case .

The case pertains to Barcelona allegedly paying millions of dollars to the company of Jose Maria Enriquez Negreira, the former vice president of Spanish football’s refereeing committee, between 2001 and 2018, to try to influence referee decisions.

Meanwhile, on Monday, Barcelona President Joan Laporta criticised Real Madrid for “constantly attacking” La Liga.

Real have demanded Javier Tebas’s resignation from his positions as La Liga chief and vice president of the Royal Spanish Football Federation after he compared rhetoric from ⁠⁠the club’s management ⁠⁠to the propaganda methods used by the Nazi Party in Germany.

Who has dominated El Clasico in recent years?

The overall head-to-head record is tied, with 106 wins each and 52 draws.

If you look at El Clasicos over the last five years, it is a close battle – Barca have won 10 times, while Real have won nine.

Looking at the last 10 clashes, Barca again have a slight edge, winning six times, while Real have four wins.

Who are the favourites in Sunday’s El Clasico?

As the current league leaders, Barcelona are strong favourites to win on Sunday.

Barca have won nine out of nine La Liga matches this season, while Real have lost two and sit third, six points behind Barca.

Should Barca emerge victorious, it would make it two El Clasico wins in a row, following their 2-0 win last season , on May 10.

That result was extra special for the Catalan club as it meant they retained the title, and it marked only the second time the outcome of La Liga had been decided directly by the result of El Clasico.

articles.title: North Wales Crusaders set for RFL talks over future
articles.summary: North Wales Crusaders officials will hold talks with the RFL who say the club have been unable to satisfy financial requirements.
articles.body:
North Wales Crusaders officials are to hold talks with the Rugby Football League (RFL) in a bid to save the club.

Crusaders withdrew from the process of bidding for a licence for 2027 earlier this week.

The RFL have said the club had been unable to satisfy their requests for next year.

The governing body have been looking for Crusaders to deposit £150,000 in an escrow account to prove financial funding is in place.

Crusaders will present a revised business plan when they meet RFL officials later on Friday.

Chairman Jamie Elkaleh said the club had received "overwhelmingly positive and supportive" messages following the announcement.

Wales' only professional rugby league side had been on the brink of collapse earlier this year when the owners announced they would no longer provide funding, only months after they had won the League One title.

A group of supporters and volunteers rallied and a new company, NW Rugby League 26 Ltd, was formed and granted an interim licence by the RFL.

The club was deducted 12 points as punishment for its financial failings, and completed the 2026 season with a hastily reassembled squad.

Crusaders finished bottom of the Championship, losing 21 of their 24 games.

Their 134-0 defeat by London Broncos in June was the biggest loss of any side in the top two divisions in the 131-year history of rugby league.

articles.title: 'Double standard': Özil wants football sanctions against Russia lifted
articles.summary: Former Germany midfielder Mesut Özil has called on footballl authorities to end sanctions against Russia, accusing them of double standard because Israel has...
articles.body:
Former Germany midfielder Mesut Özil has called on footballl authorities to end sanctions against Russia, accusing them of double standard because Israel has not been banned.

World governing body FIFA and Europe's UEFA have banned Russian teams from international events since the start of Russia's invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.

Israel has been criticised over the military operation in Gaza it started after the Hamas group attacked Israel in October 2023. It is not been sanctioned by football authorities.

Özil, who helped Germany win the World Cup in 2014, spoke out on the sidelines of a veterans' game between his former Turkish club Başakşehir and Russian side Zenit St Petersburg earlier in the week.

"I'd like to say this: football has always brought peace. As long as we don't focus on race or religion, the world of sport has always brought people together," he said.

"As is well known, and as you know, FIFA has not imposed any sanctions on Israeli teams, but it has done so against Russian teams.

"Here, I would like to appeal, as they say, to FIFA. Hopefully, they will stop applying double standards and treat everyone equally. That is why I would like to thank you all for organising this event."

Özil has supported the Palestinian case in the past, including two years ago on Instagram where he posted a map with the name Israel crossed out and Palestine written underneath.

Germany-born Özil played for Schalke, Werder Bremen, Real Madrid, Arsenal, Fenerbahçe and Başakşehir, where he ended his career in 2023. He won 92 Germany caps but retired from the team in 2018 over a controversy around a picture that showed him with Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan.

articles.title: Michael Carrick is '100%' confident he can turn around Man Utd form
articles.summary: Michael Carrick is 100% certain he can turn things around at Manchester United after the under-fire manager began his press conference with an emotional spee...
articles.body:
Michael Carrick is 100% certain he can turn things around at Manchester United after the under-fire manager began his press conference with an emotional speech about the state of the club.

The 45-year-old's position is hanging in the balance after Wednesday's calamitous 4-1 Champions League loss at Como extended their winless to a seventh match in all competitions - the club's worse run of form since 2015.

Carrick will take charge of Sunday's return to Premier League action at home to Bournemouth but there is a sense that it may only prove a stay of execution for the United head coach.

But the former midfielder will not go down without a fight and began Friday's press conference with a defiant five-minute speech, admitting "we've kind of lost our way a little bit" but "we'll get it back".

"There's always conversations going on," Carrick said when he faced his first question. "I think it's pretty obvious how we're all feeling.

"The responsibility for me to be in this position is to lead. It is my responsibility whatever goes on the pitch, what we are as a group and what we look like and what we feel like.

"If anything, to hold that umbrella for me to get wet and for everyone else to stay dry. You know, that's the position I'm in, and it's a privileged position.

"Discussions are going on, getting the players in a good frame of mind and well organised to put in a good performance on Sunday."

Asked if he is convinced he can still turn things around at United, Carrick said: "Yeah, yeah, 100%."

articles.title: Latest update on Bears TE Cole Kmet's knee injury
articles.summary: Chicago Bears tight end Cole Kmet suffered a knee injury against the New England Patriots. We're tracking the latest updates.
articles.body:
The Chicago Bears defeated the New England Patriots, 30-24, in a statement win on Thursday Night Football. But they suffered a massive blow with tight end Cole Kmet going down with a knee injury late in the game.

Kmet suffered a knee injury midway through the fourth quarter after hauling in an 8-yard pass on the team's second-to-last possession. Kmet was carted off the field but gave a thumbs up to the Soldier Field crowd as he was taken to the locker room. Still, it wasn't an encouraging sign for one of the Bears ' fan-favorite players and underrated contributors on offense, especially as he was immediately ruled out of the game.

There's concern about Kmet's status moving forward. But what's the latest on his injury?

Photos from Bears' statement win over the Patriots in Week 7

The Bears offense suffered a big loss with tight end Cole Kmet suffering a knee injury late in the fourth quarter after catching an 8-yard pass. Kmet was carted off the field and immediately ruled out of the game. After the game, head coach Ben Johnson said the team would know more Monday after the severity of Kmet's injury, although he admitted that "it didn't look good." Kmet has been a crucial part of the Bears' offense, even though it's come less as a pass catcher and more as a blocker lately. In Thursday's win over the Patriots, Kmet caught three passes for 28 yards, but he also played a key role as a blocker.

It's currently unknown how much time Cole Kmet will miss after his knee injury. In the moment, it didn't look good -- and head coach Ben Johnson admitted as much after the game -- but the team will do more tests to determine the severity and how much time he'll miss.

Regardless of how long Cole Kmet misses, Colston Loveland will continue to see action in the passing game and as a blocker. But with Kmet's absence, it will give more opportunities for third-round rookie Sam Roush, who's seen limited action and has had some early struggles in his first season. But the additional reps will be valuable for Roush's development in the long-term.
